name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A free starter pack that turns a general AI assistant into a specialist for a specific job, like sales, legal, or finance, already wired up to the tools that job uses.
buyer: An operations or IT leader at a mid-size company rolling out AI assistants to non-technical teams (sales, support, finance, legal) who wants role-specific setups instead of building prompts from scratch.
business_use_cases: A consulting firm customizes the 'legal' or 'finance' plugin with a client's terminology and internal tools, then sells the customized setup as a paid implementation package.
An agency that serves customer-support teams takes the 'customer-support' plugin and turns it into a packaged onboarding product for SMB helpdesks.
A fractional ops consultant uses the 'sales' plugin to quickly stand up AI-assisted outreach workflows for multiple small-business clients.

money_ideas.idea: Charge a flat implementation fee to customize and connect one of these plugins (connectors, terminology, workflows) to a specific client's tool stack.
Offer an ongoing 'AI workflow maintenance' retainer that keeps a company's customized plugin set up to date as their tools and processes change.

steal_this: Pick one plugin (e.g. customer-support or sales), customize it for one real local business this weekend, and pitch it as a fixed-price 'AI assistant setup' package.
